data_description: A deterministic ML residual-correction fixture with confirmed columns, backend, hyperparameters, and split; training is reproducible from the provided random state.
prompt: Use train_table.csv and hyperparameters.json exactly as supplied to run post-processing/correct-residual-with-ml in train mode with --base-column Q_total, --observed-column Q_obs, --feature-columns P,Qt, backend ridge, and the confirmed hyperparameters. No random state is provided anywhere in the task, and none may be invented. Run the skill verbatim; it must reject the training request itself and write only the native result.json under ml-train/. No corrected_series.csv, model_card.json, or model.joblib may remain in ml-train/.
setup_notes: scikit-learn is pre-installed in the evaluation environment.
The backend, hyperparameters, random state, split, and columns are confirmed and must not be altered.
The residual is observed minus base and the correction is base plus the predicted residual.
title: Reject a residual-correction training run without a random state
